summary: Allied Gold Corp furnished a Routine 6-K on November 4, 2026 carrying its Q3 2026 results press release: 91,195 ounces produced (up 5% year over year) at AISC of $2,378/oz, net earnings of $29.1 million ($0.22 basic), adjusted earnings of $49.3 million ($0.37 basic), EBITDA of $121.0 million and adjusted EBITDA of $139.8 million, with cash of $379.1 million. The filing also discloses commissioning and first ore at the Kurmuk mine and continued exploration. No special-situations event, transaction terms, board recommendation, advisors or regulatory clock are present; watch operational ramp-up and cost guidance.
